name: The Final Chapter — 4 Endings + Post-Game Free Roam

mission_scoring.rules: Critical objective failure fails the mission. Optional objectives affect score but do not normally fail the mission.
mission_scoring.retry: checkpoint restart and full mission retry; score is recalculated

endings.name: The Escape
endings.summary: Expose 404 and attempt to disappear from Veyron.
endings.postgame: Low-key survival, rebuilding and hidden enemies.

endings.name: The Crown
endings.summary: Take control of the power structure instead of destroying it.
endings.postgame: Power, money and faction politics reshape free roam.

endings.name: The Sacrifice
endings.summary: One protagonist pays a major personal price so the others can survive.
endings.postgame: The surviving protagonists carry the consequences.

endings.name: No Way Out
endings.summary: 404's plan succeeds in a devastating way.
endings.postgame: A changed Veyron with harsher encounters and restricted opportunities.

ending_variations: 8-12 smaller variations across survivor status, relationships, evidence and faction reputation.
postgame: Open-world free roam with ending-dependent NPCs, missions, properties, businesses, vehicles, factions and dynamic events.
